address: Rua Prof. Tamandaré Toledo, 160, São Paulo, 04532-020, Brazil
bio: Young chefs Júlia Tricate and Gabriel Coelho already have impressive CVs, having won TV food competitions and worked in Michelin-starred restaurants such as Noma (Copenhagen) and Oro (Rio de Janeiro). Following on from these incredible experiences, they decided to open their own restaurant with an open kitchen and a discreet decor that helps to channel the complete focus onto their cuisine. Their modern culinary vision is showcased on a creative menu that champions fresh, seasonal ingredients on a tasting menu, à la carte and midweek “executive” menu”.
